tagline: A food and nutrition student who learns, explores, and grows through diverse experiences.
shortBio: Grounded in food science and nutritional biochemistry, I am deeply passionate about food processing, product development, and food safety quality assurance. Bridging major expertise with data science, business insights, and smart digital tools, I continuously strive to solve real-world industry challenges and pioneer meaningful value.

interests.title: Food Processing, Development & Industry
interests.description: Exploring customized dietary solutions and functional meal kits aligned with cutting-edge FoodTech trends and modern consumer lifestyles.

interests.title: Food Hygiene, Safety & Quality Assurance
interests.description: Committed to rigorous hygiene compliance, scientific QA, and HACCP standards in foodservice and institutional dining facilities.

interests.title: Data Analytics & Business Convergence
interests.description: Applying statistical regression, machine learning, and management information systems to analyze consumer patterns and supply chain risks.

aboutSections.title: Academic Foundations and Inquiry
aboutSections.content: Since matriculating at Hallym University in 2023 in Food Science and Nutrition, I have built solid foundations in nutritional biology, food chemistry, culinary principles, and food hygiene. Moving beyond textbook knowledge, I have validated scientific mechanisms through laboratory experiments, fieldwork, and in-depth analytical reporting.

aboutSections.title: Vision for Food Processing and Development
aboutSections.content: Food is a vital medium that shapes individual quality of life. Through projects such as the 'DASH-T' chrononutrition meal-kit design for hypertension and extensive research into global FoodTech trends, I have honed the capability to formulate scientifically backed, highly viable food solutions tailored to modern living.

aboutSections.title: Field Experience in Food Hygiene and Safety
aboutSections.content: During my dietitian field internship at the Center for Children and Social Welfare Foodservice Management, I conducted hygiene audits, ATP contamination testing, and created safety educational cards for kitchen workers. This experience cemented my conviction that safety and hygiene are foundational trust-builders with consumers.

aboutSections.title: Cross-Disciplinary Growth: Data and Business
aboutSections.content: Through coursework in management information systems, machine learning classification, multiple regression analysis, and corporate CSR case studies, I have expanded my perspective. Combining nutritional science with data-driven decision-making, I am advancing as a well-rounded professional ready for future food industry leadership.
